menu.tagline: Build your own consultancy. One quarter at a time.
menu.disclaimer: Any resemblance to real companies is purely coincidental (and meant with love).

newGame.title: Start a company
newGame.name: Company name
newGame.foundersHint: Pick two. The founders are your first stars, and they never leave.

difficultyHints.easy: NOK 5M in starting capital and friendly competitors.
difficultyHints.normal: NOK 3M in starting capital. Competitors behave like the real thing.
difficultyHints.hard: NOK 1.5M and hungry competitors. Good luck.

save.title: Save game
save.autosaveInfo: The game autosaves every quarter. Here you can save a separate copy.
save.failed: Couldn't save. Your browser may not allow storage.

bjorn.name: Chairman Bjørn
bjorn.start: Welcome! We have a small gig at Kryptonitt. The rest you'll have to win yourself.
bjorn.inCredit: We're living on the credit line now. The bank sends Christmas cards, but not the nice kind.
bjorn.heat: I don't want to know what you're up to. But be careful.
bjorn.overworked: People are working too much. Good for this quarter, bad for the next.
bjorn.bench: Too many people on the bench. Win something, or rethink the staffing.
bjorn.losing: We're losing money. That's not a strategy.
bjorn.growing: We're growing. Remember people need to be happy too.
bjorn.fine: Steady as she goes. The board is pleased, meaning me.
bjorn.endLost: It didn't work out this time. The next company will be better.
bjorn.endGreat: Impressive. I'll take the credit at the next board meeting.
bjorn.endOk: A proper company. That's more than most manage.

dashboard.lastQuarter: Last quarter: {{revenue}} revenue, {{result}} result, {{hires}} in and {{leavers}} out.

office.label: Your office
office.more_one: … and {{count}} more at a co-working space.
office.more_other: … and {{count}} more at a co-working space.

staff.fireHint: Severance: {{cost}}. Everyone else gets a bit less happy.
staff.recruitInfo: About {{rate}} accept. Expected: {{expected}} new next quarter. Recruiting cost: {{cost}} per hire.
staff.marketEmpty: No stars available right now. Check back next quarter.

fagHints.zero: No tech days, no conferences. People learn from Stack Overflow.
fagHints.low: A tech evening now and then. With pizza.
fagHints.mid: Guilds, tech days and the odd conference.
fagHints.high: Conference trips, certifications and your own tech blog.
fagHints.max: You have your own conference. And podcast. And a guild for guilds.

sosHints.zero: No Friday drinks. People start going out with competitors.
sosHints.low: Coffee and a Christmas budget that calls for a potluck.
sosHints.mid: Friday drinks, a summer party and a proper coffee machine.
sosHints.high: Cabin trips, kick-offs abroad and kombucha on tap.
sosHints.max: Nobody ever wants to go home. It's a bit worrying.

salaryHints.low: Below market. Cheap now, expensive later.
salaryHints.high: Above market. People stay, and headhunters give up.

culture.explain: Budgets apply to all {{hc}} employees. Engineering culture wins tenders and brings in stronger hires. Social culture keeps people. Both build up over time.

tenders.title: Tender board
tenders.intro: Tenders are decided at the end of their deadline quarter and start the quarter after. Green seats you can staff yourself, yellow partly. The rest are filled with freelancers.
tenders.freeHint: You'll have {{free}} available when it starts.
tenders.lastChance: Last chance: decided when you end the quarter!

bid.title: Offer to {{customer}}
bid.frameworkInfo: The top three get an agreement, with 60, 30 and 10% of the call-offs.
bid.noStars: You have no stars to offer yet.
bid.pitchHint: One attempt per tender. Choose a meeting or bingo.
bid.estimateHint: A rough estimate. Competitors and the client's mood can surprise you.

minigame.oneShot: You only get one attempt per tender.

contracts.title: Contracts
contracts.none: No active contracts. The tender board awaits.
contracts.explain: Low satisfaction can get you fired. Freelancers and outsourcing drag it down, good people lift it.

market.explain: You're in place {{rank}}. You only see other firms' morale with intel from the backroom.

backroom.title: The Backroom
backroom.intro: This is where things happen that don't make the annual report. Everything has a price, and sometimes you get caught.
backroom.confirm: Are you ABSOLUTELY sure? Your compliance department is one guy called Tor, and he reads everything.
backroom.noStars: They have no stars to steal.
backroom.noOwnBids: You need to place a bid first.
backroom.shareHint: 0% turns outsourcing off. A higher share means more margin and more risk.
backroom.noIntel: You know nothing. Maybe that's for the best.
backroom.intelBids: You can see all bids on the tender from {{customer}}.
backroom.intelFirm: morale {{morale}}, pay {{premium}}% above market, engineering culture {{fag}}, {{hc}} people.

end.title: Ten years later…
end.summary: You finished {{rank}} of {{total}} with a value of {{value}}.
end.shady: You did {{total}} shady things and got caught {{detected}} times.
